Personal Training

Set Your Goals. Make the Progress.

Everyone’s journey to fitness looks different, and no two people are the same or have the same needs. At the Y, our Certified Personal Trainers understand that more than anyone and will work with you to create an exercise program tailored to you, your goals, and your needs. Before you know it you’ll be exercising much more effectively and efficiently!

This program is exclusively for members of the Mecklenburg County YMCA.
